Alexandrie, le 17 Juin 1921

Mon cher frère,
[...]
Compte Crédit. Le point qui reste sur le P.O. de la somme de £6000, [somme] envoyée par Mizrahi. Je passe sans avoir visé les remerciements; veuillez [faire] les [remerciements] suivant la lettre [reçue] de Lata.
Lata a [écrit] et [a accusé réception ...]. Nous le [lui] enverrons demain. Je n’ai pas pu voir Mizrahi car il est en voyage; je téléphonerai. Je vous écrirai à la fin de la lettre [...] seulement qu’elle [enverra] les encaissements [...].
[...]
Samuel [...] Salomon. Ils vont [...]

ALEXANDRIA
Maronite Church Street, No. 1
Telephone 44-46
Telegraphic address: "BEHNA, ALEXANDRIA"

CAIRO
Rue Neuve (New Street), No. 49
Telephone No. 50-723  P.O. Box 120
Telegraphic address: "ANKEB, CAIRO"

Rachid Behna
Merchant

Alexandria, 17 June 1921

My dear brother,
[...]
Credit account. The item remaining on the P.O. of the amount of £6000, [sum] sent by Mizrahi. I am passing without having checked the acknowledgements; please make the acknowledgements according to the letter received from Lata.
Lata has written and acknowledged receipt [...]. We will send it tomorrow. I could not see Mizrahi as he is traveling; I will telephone. I will write to you at the end of the letter [...] only that she will send the payments [...].
[...]
Samuel [...] Salomon. They will [...]
[end, handwritten portions partly illegible]
